corePrinciples: Expand the pitch maximally in possession; compress it minimally out of possession
System efficiency > sum of individuals — coalitions and connections
Short-team compactness (classic 4-4-2: ≤ ~25m deepest defender to striker)
Positional play spacing: avoid overcrowding the same line (playbook grid: ≤3 on a horizontal line, ≤2 vertically in the same channel)

spacing: GK steps out as sweeper-keeper into a triangle with split CBs
CBs split to edges of the 18-yard box to stretch the first press
Single pivot drops between CBs → temporary back-three / numerical edge vs 2-striker press
Full-backs push high on touchlines to drag opposition wingers deep
patterns: Short diagonals into midfield lanes opened by CB split
boardCues: Ball with GK/CBs in RIGHT third
ATT #6 between/ beside CBs
FBs high-wide; front three not cluttering first line
DEF press on box edge (default high)

spacing: Flank triangles: FB + #8 + winger rotate on each side
No more than 3 on same horizontal; no more than 2 stacked vertically in a channel
Single pivot as conductor — short sideways then diagonal switch
patterns: If FB advances, CM drops laterally, winger tucks to open touchline
Support angles always behind and in front of the ball-carrier
boardCues: Focus MIDDLE; show one active flank triangle
Pivot receives/shifts; opposite winger ready for switch
After high-press F1: bypassed STs recover; cover becomes jump

spacing: False nine drops between midfield and back line
Inverted wingers diagonal runs in behind
FBs overlap for cutbacks into POMO
#8/#10 late box runs
patterns: False nine drag → winger slice → FB cutback
Late midfield arrivals overload the box
boardCues: Focus LEFT third
#9 dropped or arriving late; wingers inside; FBs high-wide
DEF recovering to box

spacing: Nearest 3 swarm ball within 3–5 seconds (Gegenpress)
High line + squeeze vertical space (rest defense)
If bypassed → compact zonal block
boardCues: Cluster 3 ATT pressers on ball
CBs stepped up; no huge gaps behind midfield

4-4-2.label: Zonal Pressing & Balanced Lines
4-4-2.widthSource: Asymmetrical: one wide mid stays wide / other tucks; opposite FB overlaps

spacing: Back four as coordinated sliding arc
Two CMs sit directly in front of CBs as deep double screen (not dropping into back line)
FBs relatively deep initially as sideways outlets
boardCues: Flat back four + two CMs screening
Front two higher; wide mids balanced
Vs high press: keep short distances

spacing: Whole team moves as one block ≤25m deepest to striker
Lateral slide with the ball
Asymmetry: one WM wide, opposite WM tucks to overload center
patterns: Feed forwards when block is set
boardCues: Show compact block mid-pitch
One tuck + one wide platform arrow
Highlight short-team distance

spacing: Target hold-up + agile runner partnership
Wide: one side crosses from touchline; other side tuck frees overlapping FB
CMs late to edge of box
boardCues: Twin STs linked; asymmetric flanks
Cutback/cross channel marked

spacing: Two lines of four drop to low/mid block instantly
Nearest mid+ST harass; rest slide laterally
Back four step for offside trap in unison
boardCues: Compact 4+4 block; no large vertical gaps
If coach asked low block — allow deeper DEF

spacing: CBs split wide
Two holding mids sit symmetrically — if one pressed, other offers support angle
FBs liberated high-wide because pivots secure the center
patterns: Short into pivots → out to advanced FBs or into midfield
boardCues: Show #6+#8 platform in front of split CBs
FBs high; #10/#7/#11/#9 not collapsing on first line

spacing: Pivots + #10 form flexible triangle / midfield square
Wingers and #10 occupy vertical channels
If press narrow → swivel to overlapping FBs; if press wide → wingers tuck for central overload
boardCues: Ball into #10 pocket highlight
One flank overlap OR central tuck overload — not both cluttered

spacing: #10 as enganche behind lone ST
Wingers cut inside channels
FBs overlap for width/cross
ST mobile target to unpin CBs → five-man wave
boardCues: #10 between lines; ST pinning; wingers inside; FBs high

spacing: Doble pivot rarely both join attack — permanent rest-defense screen
On loss: pivots close central channels
Wingers+#10 drop to 4-5-1 / 4-4-2 out-of-possession shape
boardCues: Two deep screens stay; front players drop on transition frame

3-5-2.label: Wing-Back Overloads & Central Anchors
3-5-2.pivotStyle: Libero + DM sluice + triple central midfield

spacing: GK short to back three
Middle CB as ball-playing libero carries into midfield
Side CBs split as outlets
DM drops as sluice gate in front of back three
Wing-backs push high to stretch the press
patterns: Triangles across back three and DM
boardCues: Back three visible; libero stepped; WBs midfield-high
Vs 2-ST press: 3 CBs advantage

spacing: Natural 5-man midfield overload
WBs high-wide drag opponents → open central channels
Contra swaps: CMs rotate with WBs; libero drives; DM covers
boardCues: Five midfield shirts in middle third
Show one contra/rotation arrow set

spacing: #10 free between lines (playmaker playground)
WBs to goal line for crosses / cut-ins
Twin STs central
CMs late box; libero recycles at midfield edge
boardCues: Max width from WBs; #10 central; two STs in box

spacing: WBs drop to form five-man back line (5-3-2)
Three CBs tight vs crosses
Three central mids shield; force play wide then isolate
boardCues: Transition frame shows 5 across back, 3 mid shield
